text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios tells Daiichi Ruby she'll 
pull off a miracle in the Arima Kinen. 
Ruby resolves to witness it together with 
K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the two of them showing up, Daitaku 
Helios is hyped to the max. Teaming up 
with her bestie Mejiro Palmer, they've 
just gotta throw the wildest bash in 
earth's history!
